The only missing detail is the specific verification of claw structure due to image quality, but the overall anatomy is correct.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from significant softness/blur (likely photographic or motion blur given the Perceptual Auditor's 'null' finding on AI-specific distortions). The Pose Auditor's low confidence in the shoulder and hip regions supports this structural ambiguity. It is better than the 'mid' reference (hammerhead) which had more obvious structural issues, but worse than the 'high' reference (bird) which was sharp and clean.
